mapper.select: SELECT /* SESSION.retrieveProjectSessionData */ em.subsidiary_code /* 법인코드 */ , em.employee_number AS employee_no /* 로그인 사용자 사번 */ , em.organization_id /* 로그인 사용자 조직ID */ , em.assignment_category AS employment_category_code /* 재량권 조회시 사용 */ , cv.organization_id AS operating_unit_id , em.attribute10 AS shift_type_code , em.fse_yn /* FSE 여부 */ , em.flsa_yn /* 단기파견자 여부 */ FROM emp_master em , lgcom_user_m um , lgcom_company_v cv WHERE um.application_user_id = #{USER_SESSION.applicationUserId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND em.employee_number = um.user_name AND cv.short_code = em.subsidiary_code UNION ALL SELECT cv.short_code AS subsidiary_code /* 법인코드 */ , um.user_name AS employee_no /* 로그인 사용자 사번 */ , NULL AS organization_id /* 로그인 사용자 조직ID */ , NULL AS employment_category_code /* 재량권 조회시 사용 */ , um.default_org_id AS operating_unit_id , NULL AS shift_type_code , 'Y' AS fse_yn /* FSE 여부 */ , 'Y' AS flsa_yn /* 단기파견자 여부 */ FROM lgcom_user_m um , lgcom_company_v CV , lgcom_common_code_c cc WHERE um.application_user_id = #{USER_SESSION.applicationUserId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND cv.organization_id = um.default_org_id AND cc.code_type_code = 'LGVCOM_SYSTEM_ADMIN_ID' /* system admin */ AND cc.common_code = um.user_name AND cc.use_flag = 'Y' AND trunc(SYSDATE) BETWEEN cc.apply_start_date AND NVL(cc.apply_end_date, trunc(SYSDATE))
